text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her Debut race, Mejiro 
Ardan gained confidence in her start, but 
she was so thoroughly exhausted that she 
nearly collapsed afterward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although an examination at the hospital 
confirmed nothing was critically wrong, 
Mejiro Ardan was taken to a resort owned 
by the Mejiro family to rest and recover.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reason she collapsed was simple: once 
the race ended, the fatigue and tension 
accumulated in her mind and body suddenly 
overwhelmed her all at once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family's personal physician 
reveals that it would be best for her to 
temporarily step away from racing and rest 
quietly for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Ardan's Trainer, what is the 
right path to take? That decision was 
pressing ever closer...
